d:
Get moving with this feel-good 20-minute low impact home workout set to country music! No jumping, no equipment needed — just good vibes and a great sweat. Perfect for beginners, those returning to fitness, or anyone who wants a joint-friendly workout that's actually fun.
Whether you're a country music lover or just looking for a low impact cardio workout you'll actually enjoy, this one's for you!
WHAT TO EXPECT:
20 minutes of low impact movement
Country music to keep you motivated
Beginner friendly modifications throughout
No equipment needed
2271 steps with music set to 120 BPM
